# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(emmeans)
library(janitor)
library(effectsize)
library(broom)
library(kableExtra)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)
library(ggdist)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)

# helper rescale to 0-1
rescale01 <- function(x, min_val, max_val) {
  (x - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
}

# Helper: significance stars
sig_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p))  return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  if (p < 0.10)  return("†")
  return("")
}

# Display-only helpers for the LaTeX exports, mirroring the Study 1/2 scripts.
group_display_labels <- c(
  neutral   = "\\textsc{Neutral}",
  debunking = "\\textsc{Debunking}",
  interview = "\\textsc{Interview}",
  empathy   = "\\textsc{Empathy}",
  roleplay  = "\\textsc{Roleplay}",
  # The flyer-baseline robustness tables go through the same export helper, so
  # the baseline is relabelled too; otherwise those rows would read
  # "\textsc{Debunking} - flyer".
  flyer     = "\\textsc{Flyer}"
)

relabel_groups_in_string <- function(x) {
  for (k in names(group_display_labels)[order(-nchar(names(group_display_labels)))]) {
    x <- gsub(k, group_display_labels[[k]], x, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  x
}

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "$<$0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))

# Columns that carry condition names, and columns that carry p-values, in the
# tables this document exports.
export_label_columns <- c("contrast", "Contrast", "condition", "Condition", "Group")
export_p_columns     <- c("p_holm", "p_unadjusted", "p_one_sided", "p", "p.value")

# escape = FALSE is required so the \textsc labels survive kable(); that in
# turn means the column headers have to be LaTeX-safe, because a raw
# underscore would be read as a subscript outside math mode.
export_col_names <- function(df) {
  lookup <- c(
    contrast     = "Contrast",
    condition    = "Condition",
    estimate     = "Estimate",
    effect_size  = "Cohen's $d$",
    df           = "$df$",
    t            = "$t$",
    p_holm       = "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm}}$",
    p_unadjusted = "$p$",
    p_one_sided  = "$p$",
    p_holm_within_dv = "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm}}$",
    Eng_control  = "Engagement control",
    CI_low       = "LB$_{95}$",
    CI_high      = "UB$_{95}$",
    stars        = "Sig."
  )
  nm  <- names(df)
  hit <- nm %in% names(lookup)
  nm[hit] <- unname(lookup[nm[hit]])
  # Mapped headers are already math-mode and must be left alone; anything
  # unmapped falls back to replacing the underscore with a space.
  nm[!hit] <- gsub("_", " ", nm[!hit])
  nm
}

prep_table_for_export <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(export_label_columns), relabel_groups_in_string)) %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(export_p_columns), fmt_p))
}
```

```{r review-helpers}

STUDY_NUM <- "3"
STUDY_TAG <- "s3"

# p-value and significance formatting used by all new exports (LaTeX-safe).
fmt_p3 <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "",
                      ifelse(p < 0.001, "$<$0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
p_txt  <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< .001", sprintf("= %.3f", p))   # for prose
stars3 <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(is.na(p) ~ "", p < .001 ~ "***", p < .01 ~ "**",
                                       p < .05 ~ "*", p < .10 ~ "†", TRUE ~ "")
stars_tex <- function(s) gsub("†", "$\\dagger$", s, fixed = TRUE)

# Study 2 has group_display_labels but not relabel_groups_in_string; define it
# if missing so every export uses the same \textsc{} labels.
if (!exists("relabel_groups_in_string")) {
  relabel_groups_in_string <- function(x) {
    keys <- names(group_display_labels)[order(-nchar(names(group_display_labels)))]
    for (k in keys) x <- gsub(k, group_display_labels[[k]], x, fixed = TRUE)
    x
  }
}

# Sample-flow recorder for Table 1 (see section D). `key` is a stable id used
# by the Table 1 assembler; `step` is the human-readable row label.
flow <- tibble::tibble(key = character(), step = character(), n = integer(), note = character())
flow_add <- function(flow, key, step, n, note = "") {
  dplyr::bind_rows(flow, tibble::tibble(key = key, step = step, n = as.integer(n), note = note))
}

if (!dir.exists("tables")) dir.create("tables")
```

```{r}
}

                 nrow(data), note = sprintf("%d removed", n_before - nrow(data)))

n_before <- nrow(data); data <- dplyr::filter(data, attention_pass %in% TRUE)

flow <- flow_add(flow, "after_attention", "After attention-check exclusion", nrow(data))

# Completion time is the post-survey end minus the pre-survey start, as in
# Studies 1-2 and in the original main-study cleaning.
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    StartDate.x = na_if(StartDate.x, ""),
    EndDate.y   = na_if(EndDate.y, ""),
    StartDate.x = parse_date_time(StartDate.x, orders = c("Ymd HMS", "Y-m-d H:M:S", "m/d/Y H:M", "d.m.Y H:M:S")),
    EndDate.y   = parse_date_time(EndDate.y,   orders = c("Ymd HMS", "Y-m-d H:M:S", "m/d/Y H:M", "d.m.Y H:M:S")),
```

# Demographics



## Demographics cleaning

```{r}


clean_demographics <- function(df) {
  df %>%
  mutate(
    # age: collapse into 3 groups + unknown
    age3 = case_when(
      age %in% c("18-24", "25-34") ~ "young",
      age %in% c("35-44", "45-54") ~ "middle",
      age %in% c("55-64", "65 or older") ~ "older",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    age3 = factor(age3, levels = c("young", "middle", "older", "unknown")),

    # gender: collapse tiny categories
    gender3 = case_when(
      gender == "Male" ~ "Male",
      gender == "Female" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    gender3 = factor(gender3, levels = c("Male", "Female", "Other")),

    # employment: collapse multi-select chaos
    employment3 = case_when(
      grepl("full-time", employment, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Full-time",
      grepl("part-time|student", employment, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Part-time/Student",
      TRUE ~ "Other/Not working"
    ),
    employment3 = factor(
      employment3,
      levels = c("Full-time", "Part-time/Student", "Other/Not working")
    ),

    # children: binary (the raw Qualtrics item codes "no children" as 0)
    children_bin = ifelse(as.character(children) == "0", "No children", "Has children"),
    children_bin = factor(children_bin, levels = c("No children", "Has children")),

    # economic situation: keep as is
    economic_situation = factor(
      economic_situation,
      levels = c("Low income", "Middle income", "High income", "Prefer not to say")
    ),

    # religion: collapse into 3 groups
    religion3 = case_when(
      religion == "No religious affiliation" ~ "None",
      religion == "Christianity" ~ "Christian",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    religion3 = factor(religion3, levels = c("None", "Christian", "Other")),

    # migration background: keep as is
    migration_background = factor(
      migration_background,
      levels = c("Yes", "No", "Prefer not to say")
    ),

    # sliders: numeric + z-score
    contact_1 = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", contact_1)),
    political_view_1 = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", political_view_1)),
    contact_1_z = as.numeric(scale(contact_1)),
    political_view_1_z = as.numeric(scale(political_view_1))
  )
}

main_demo <- clean_demographics(main_clean)
fu_data   <- clean_demographics(fu_data)

summary(fu_data$age3)
summary(fu_data$gender3)
summary(fu_data$employment3)
summary(fu_data$children_bin)
summary(fu_data$religion3)
```

## Demographics overview

```{r}
# Display labels (no internal coding suffixes like "3" / "_bin")
demo_var_labels <- c(
  age3 = "Age",
  gender3 = "Gender",
  employment3 = "Employment",
  children_bin = "Children",
  economic_situation = "Economic situation",
  religion3 = "Religion",
  migration_background = "Migration background"
)
cat_vars <- names(demo_var_labels)

# Italic *n* in column headers (HTML vs LaTeX)
n_header <- if (isTRUE(knitr::is_latex_output())) "$n$" else "<i>n</i>"
n_header_tex <- "$n$"

# Ensure tables/ exists for .tex exports (guard repeated per section, same
# structure as Study 1/2)
if (!dir.exists("tables")) {
  dir.create("tables")
}

# Capitalize a few collapsed age labels for display
pretty_demo_category <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(
    as.character(x),
    young = "Young",
    middle = "Middle",
    older = "Older",
    unknown = "Unknown",
    .default = as.character(x)
  )
}


export_demographics <- function(df, sample_label, file_prefix, label_prefix,
                                expected_n) {
  stopifnot(nrow(df) == expected_n)

  sample_label_html <- gsub("$", "", sample_label, fixed = TRUE)

  cat_caption  <- function(lab) sprintf(
    paste0("Demographic characteristics of the %s in Study 3 (categorical ",
           "variables). Percent is the share of the sample."), lab)
  cont_caption <- function(lab) sprintf(
    paste0("Continuous demographics of the %s in Study 3 (contact with ",
           "refugees and political views)."), lab)
  cond_caption <- function(lab) sprintf(
    paste0("Demographic characteristics of the %s in Study 3, by experimental ",
           "condition. Percent is the within-condition share."), lab)

  # Categorical summary table
  cat_table <- purrr::map_dfr(cat_vars, function(v) {
    df %>%
      janitor::tabyl(!!sym(v)) %>%
      rename(Category = !!sym(v)) %>%
      mutate(
        Variable = unname(demo_var_labels[v]),
        Category = pretty_demo_category(Category),
        # tabyl stores a proportion in `percent`; report as % of the sample
        Percent = percent * 100
      ) %>%
      select(Variable, Category, n, Percent)
  })

  # Show each variable name once; blank in subsequent rows
  cat_table_display <- cat_table %>%
    mutate(Variable = ifelse(duplicated(Variable), "", Variable))

  # Horizontal rules between variable blocks
  cat_hline_after <- which(cat_table_display$Variable != "")[-1] - 1

  cat_table_kbl <- cat_table_display %>%
    kable(
      caption = cat_caption(sample_label),
      label = paste0(label_prefix, "-cat"),
      digits = 1,
      col.names = c("Variable", "Category", n_header_tex, "Percent"),
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", "l", "r", "r"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(cat_hline_after, hline_after = TRUE)

  kableExtra::save_kable(
    cat_table_kbl,
    file = paste0("tables/", file_prefix, "_demographics_categorical.tex")
  )

  # Also render for the HTML document
  print(
    cat_table_display %>%
      kable(
        caption = cat_caption(sample_label_html),
        digits = 1,
        col.names = c("Variable", "Category", n_header, "Percent"),
        escape = FALSE,
        align = c("l", "l", "r", "r"),
        booktabs = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
      row_spec(cat_hline_after, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid #999;")
  )

  # Continuous summary table (Mean / SD columns; clear variable names)
  cont_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Variable = c(
      "Contact with refugees (0 = Never, 100 = Very often)",
      "Political views on economic issues (0 = Very liberal, 100 = Very conservative)"
    ),
    Mean = c(
      mean(df$contact_1, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(df$political_view_1, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    SD = c(
      sd(df$contact_1, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd(df$political_view_1, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

  cont_table_kbl <- cont_table %>%
    kable(
      caption = cont_caption(sample_label),
      label = paste0(label_prefix, "-cont"),
      digits = 2,
      col.names = c("Variable", "Mean", "SD"),
      align = c("l", "r", "r"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

  kableExtra::save_kable(
    cont_table_kbl,
    file = paste0("tables/", file_prefix, "_demographics_continuous.tex")
  )

  print(
    cont_table %>%
      kable(
        caption = cont_caption(sample_label_html),
        digits = 2,
        col.names = c("Variable", "Mean", "SD"),
        align = c("l", "r", "r"),
        booktabs = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
  )

  # Demographics by condition table
  demo_by_group <- purrr::map_dfr(cat_vars, function(v) {
    tab <- df %>%
      janitor::tabyl(Group, !!sym(v))

    tab_pct <- tab %>%
      janitor::adorn_percentages("row") %>%
      janitor::adorn_pct_formatting()

    tab %>%
      pivot_longer(-Group, names_to = "Category", values_to = "n") %>%
      left_join(
        tab_pct %>% pivot_longer(-Group, names_to = "Category", values_to = "Percent"),
        by = c("Group", "Category")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Variable = unname(demo_var_labels[v]),
        Category = pretty_demo_category(Category)
      ) %>%
      select(Variable, Category, Group, n, Percent)
  })

  demo_by_group_display <- demo_by_group %>%
    mutate(Variable = ifelse(duplicated(Variable), "", Variable))

  demo_hline_after <- which(demo_by_group_display$Variable != "")[-1] - 1

  demo_by_group_kbl <- demo_by_group_display %>%
    # adorn_pct_formatting() writes cells like "25.5%"; escape = FALSE is needed
    # for the math-mode n header, so the literal percent signs have to be escaped
    # here or LaTeX reads the rest of each row as a comment.
    mutate(Percent = gsub("%", "\\\\%", Percent, fixed = TRUE),
           Group   = relabel_groups_in_string(Group)) %>%
    kable(
      caption = cond_caption(sample_label),
      label = paste0(label_prefix, "-cond"),
      digits = 2,
      col.names = c("Variable", "Category", "Group", n_header_tex, "Percent"),
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(demo_hline_after, hline_after = TRUE)

  kableExtra::save_kable(
    demo_by_group_kbl,
    file = paste0("tables/", file_prefix, "_demographics_by_condition.tex")
  )

  print(
    demo_by_group_display %>%
      kable(
        caption = cond_caption(sample_label_html),
        digits = 2,
        col.names = c("Variable", "Category", "Group", n_header, "Percent"),
        escape = FALSE,
        align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r"),
        booktabs = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
      row_spec(demo_hline_after, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid #999;")
  )

  invisible(list(cat = cat_table, cont = cont_table))
}

demo_main <- export_demographics(main_demo, "final main-study sample ($N = 554$)",
                                 "study3", "s3-demo", expected_n = 554)
demo_fu   <- export_demographics(fu_data, "follow-up sample ($N = 521$)",
                                 "study3_followup", "s3-fu-demo", expected_n = 521)
```

```{r}

demo_pct <- function(demo, variable, category) {
  hit <- demo$cat$Variable == variable & demo$cat$Category == category
  stopifnot(sum(hit) == 1)
  demo$cat$Percent[hit]
}

demo_mean_sd <- function(demo, variable_pattern) {
  hit <- str_detect(demo$cont$Variable, variable_pattern)
  stopifnot(sum(hit) == 1)
  c(mean = demo$cont$Mean[hit], sd = demo$cont$SD[hit])
}

print_participants_block <- function(demo, heading) {
  pol <- demo_mean_sd(demo, "^Political views")
  con <- demo_mean_sd(demo, "^Contact with refugees")

  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    "%s\n",
    "Age:      young %.1f%%, middle %.1f%%, older %.1f%%, unknown %.1f%%\n",
    "Gender:   Female %.1f%%, Male %.1f%%, Other %.1f%%\n",
    "Political views (0-100): M = %.2f, SD = %.2f\n",
    "Contact with refugees (0-100): M = %.2f, SD = %.2f\n"),
    heading,
    demo_pct(demo, "Age", "Young"),
    demo_pct(demo, "Age", "Middle"),
    demo_pct(demo, "Age", "Older"),
    demo_pct(demo, "Age", "Unknown"),
    demo_pct(demo, "Gender", "Female"),
    demo_pct(demo, "Gender", "Male"),
    demo_pct(demo, "Gender", "Other"),
    pol[["mean"]], pol[["sd"]],
    con[["mean"]], con[["sd"]]
  ))
}

print_participants_block(
  demo_main,
  "=== Study 3 participants paragraph (final main-study sample, N = 554) ==="
)

cat("\n")

print_participants_block(
  demo_fu,
  "=== Follow-up sample (N = 521), for comparison ==="
)
```

## Holm-Corrected Confirmatory Contrasts (each treatment vs neutral)

```{r}
# Confirmatory contrast table: treatment vs neutral, Holm-corrected (one-sided, treatment > neutral)
make_confirmatory_table <- function(model, dv_label, ref = "neutral") {
  emm  <- emmeans(model, ~ Group)
  cons <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = ref)

  # The one-sided test yields a one-sided interval, so the reported 95% CI is
  # taken separately: two-sided and unadjusted, as in Study 1/2.
  ci <- confint(cons, adjust = "none", level = 0.95) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(contrast = as.character(contrast), CI_low = lower.CL, CI_high = upper.CL)

  summary(cons, adjust = "holm", side = ">") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(contrast = as.character(contrast)) %>%
    left_join(ci, by = "contrast") %>%
    mutate(
      estimate = round(estimate, 3),
      SE       = round(SE, 3),
      t        = round(t.ratio, 3),
      CI_low   = round(CI_low, 3),
      CI_high  = round(CI_high, 3),
      p_holm   = round(p.value, 4),
      stars    = map_chr(p_holm, sig_stars)
    ) %>%
    select(contrast, estimate, SE, df, t, CI_low, CI_high, p_holm, stars)
}

# Variable naming (contr_DV#_fu) mirrors contr_DV1/DV2/DV3 in Study 1/2's
# confirmatory-contrasts sections; "_fu" marks the follow-up-specific models.
contr_DV1_fu <- make_confirmatory_table(lm_DV1_fu, "DV1")
contr_DV2_fu <- make_confirmatory_table(lm_DV2_fu, "DV2")
contr_DV3_fu <- make_confirmatory_table(lm_DV3_fu, "DV3")

contr_DV1_fu %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Perceptions (Follow-Up): Holm-Corrected One-Sided Contrasts vs Neutral") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

contr_DV2_fu %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Refugee Support (Follow-Up): Holm-Corrected One-Sided Contrasts vs Neutral") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

contr_DV3_fu %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Policy Endorsement (Follow-Up): Holm-Corrected One-Sided Contrasts vs Neutral") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

# LaTeX export of the same contrast tables (mirrors save_contrast_table_tex
# in Study 1/2), saved to tables/
save_contrast_table_tex <- function(df, caption, label, file) {
  out <- prep_table_for_export(df)
  out %>%
    kable(digits = 3, caption = caption, label = label,
          format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
          escape = FALSE, col.names = export_col_names(out)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}

# Confirmatory contrast tables in the Study 1/2 format (same columns, row
# order and caption style as study1_dv#_contrasts.tex).
confirmatory_row_order <- paste(c("debunking", "interview", "empathy", "roleplay"), "- neutral")

save_confirmatory_table_tex <- function(df, caption, label, file, row_order = confirmatory_row_order) {
  stopifnot(setequal(df$contrast, row_order))
  df %>%
    arrange(match(contrast, row_order)) %>%
    transmute(Contrast = relabel_groups_in_string(contrast),
              Estimate = sprintf("%.3f", estimate), SE = sprintf("%.3f", SE), `$t$` = sprintf("%.3f", t),
              `LB$_{95}$` = sprintf("%.3f", CI_low), `UB$_{95}$` = sprintf("%.3f", CI_high),
              `$p_{\\mathrm{Holm}}$` = fmt_p3(p_holm), Sig. = stars_tex(stars3(p_holm))) %>%
    kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, label = label, caption = caption) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}

confirmatory_caption <- function(dv_label, timepoint, n) {
  sprintf(paste0("%s: confirmatory treatment-vs-\\textsc{Neutral} contrasts at %s in Study~3 ",
                 "(OLS regression of the outcome on condition, \\textsc{Neutral} as reference; $n = %d$; ",
                 "$p$ one-sided and Holm-corrected across the four contrasts; ",
                 "95\\%% confidence intervals two-sided and unadjusted). ",
                 "$^{\\dagger}p<.10$, $^{*}p<.05$, $^{**}p<.01$, $^{***}p<.001$."),
          dv_label, timepoint, n)
}

fu_caption <- function(dv_label, model) confirmatory_caption(dv_label, "the two-week follow-up", nobs(model))

save_confirmatory_table_tex(contr_DV1_fu, fu_caption("Perceptions",        lm_DV1_fu), "s3-fu-dv1", "tables/study3_followup_dv1_contrasts.tex")
save_confirmatory_table_tex(contr_DV2_fu, fu_caption("Refugee support",    lm_DV2_fu), "s3-fu-dv2", "tables/study3_followup_dv2_contrasts.tex")
save_confirmatory_table_tex(contr_DV3_fu, fu_caption("Policy endorsement", lm_DV3_fu), "s3-fu-dv3", "tables/study3_followup_dv3_contrasts.tex")
```

## Effect Sizes (Cohen's d vs neutral)

```{r}
make_effectsize_table <- function(model) {
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Group)
  eff_size(emm, sigma = sigma(model), edf = df.residual(model)) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(str_detect(contrast, "neutral")) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))
}


orient_effectsize_table <- function(model, dv_label) {
  tbl   <- make_effectsize_table(model)
  parts <- str_split_fixed(tbl$contrast, " - ", 2)
  flip  <- parts[, 1] == "neutral"

  tibble(
    DV          = dv_label,
    condition   = ifelse(flip, parts[, 2], parts[, 1]),
    contrast    = paste(ifelse(flip, parts[, 2], parts[, 1]), "- neutral"),
    effect_size = ifelse(flip, -tbl$effect.size, tbl$effect.size),
    SE          = tbl$SE,
    df          = tbl$df,
    CI_low      = ifelse(flip, -tbl$upper.CL, tbl$lower.CL),
    CI_high     = ifelse(flip, -tbl$lower.CL, tbl$upper.CL)
  )
}


cohens_d_table_fu <- bind_rows(
  orient_effectsize_table(lm_DV1_fu, "Perceptions"),
  orient_effectsize_table(lm_DV2_fu, "Refugee Support"),
  orient_effectsize_table(lm_DV3_fu, "Policy Endorsement")
)

# Every row must read "<treatment> - neutral", so that the sign of d agrees
# with the sign of the corresponding contrast estimate.
stopifnot(all(str_detect(cohens_d_table_fu$contrast, " - neutral$")))
stopifnot(nrow(cohens_d_table_fu) == 12)

cohens_d_table_fu_display <- cohens_d_table_fu %>%
  select(DV, contrast, effect_size, SE, df, CI_low, CI_high)

cohens_d_table_fu_display %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Effect Sizes vs Neutral (Cohen's d) at Follow-Up (matched sample, n = 444)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

# The two values the manuscript quotes for roleplay at follow-up.
roleplay_d_fu <- cohens_d_table_fu %>% filter(condition == "roleplay")
d_fu_roleplay_support <- roleplay_d_fu$effect_size[roleplay_d_fu$DV == "Refugee Support"]
d_fu_roleplay_policy  <- roleplay_d_fu$effect_size[roleplay_d_fu$DV == "Policy Endorsement"]

cat(sprintf("Roleplay vs neutral at follow-up (Cohen's d): refugee support = %.3f, policy endorsement = %.3f\n",
            d_fu_roleplay_support, d_fu_roleplay_policy))

# Both are positive by hypothesis direction; the tolerance keeps the printed
# values tied to the numbers quoted in the manuscript (0.28 and 0.31).
stopifnot(d_fu_roleplay_support > 0, d_fu_roleplay_policy > 0)
stopifnot(abs(d_fu_roleplay_support - 0.28) < 0.02,
          abs(d_fu_roleplay_policy  - 0.31) < 0.02)

save_contrast_table_tex(
  cohens_d_table_fu_display,
  "Study 3: effect sizes (Cohen's $d$) for each condition versus \\textsc{Neutral} at the two-week follow-up (matched sample, n = 444). Positive values indicate the treatment scored above \\textsc{Neutral}.",
  "s3-fu-d",
  "tables/study3_followup_effectsizes.tex"
)
```

# Confirmatory Plots



```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=15}
desired_order <- c("Neutral", "Debunking", "Interview", "Empathy", "Roleplay")

# Axes are shown on the original response scales (DV1: 1-5 Likert;
# DV2/DV3: 0-100 sliders), matching the other study figures. Models are still
# fit on the 0-1 DVs, so the Delta annotations remain in 0-1 scale units.
plot_data_fu <- fu_no_flyer %>%
  select(anon_id, Group,
         DV1 = DV1_perceptions_fu,
         DV2 = DV2_support_fu,
         DV3 = DV3_policy_fu) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("DV"), names_to = "DV", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(
    score_original = case_when(
      DV == "DV1" ~ score * 4 + 1,      # 0-1 -> 1-5
      DV == "DV2" ~ score * 100,        # 0-1 -> 0-100
      DV == "DV3" ~ score * 100,        # 0-1 -> 0-100
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

conf_tables <- list(DV1 = contr_DV1_fu, DV2 = contr_DV2_fu, DV3 = contr_DV3_fu)

dv_scales <- list(
  DV1 = c(1, 5),
  DV2 = c(0, 100),
  DV3 = c(0, 100)
)

# Explicit breaks so the annotation headroom does not add ticks beyond the
# response scale (e.g. a "6" on the 1-5 Likert axis).
dv_breaks <- list(
  DV1 = 1:5,
  DV2 = seq(0, 100, by = 25),
  DV3 = seq(0, 100, by = 25)
)

dv_plot_labels <- list(
  DV1 = "Perceptions (Follow-up)",
  DV2 = "Refugee Support (Follow-up)",
  DV3 = "Policy Endorsement (Follow-up)"
)

plot_dv_fu <- function(dv_name) {

  df <- plot_data_fu %>%
    filter(DV == dv_name) %>%
    mutate(Group_plot = factor(str_to_title(Group), levels = desired_order))

  sum_sub <- df %>%
    group_by(Group_plot) %>%
    summarise(
      mean  = mean(score_original),
      sd    = sd(score_original),
      n     = n(),
      se    = sd / sqrt(n),
      lower = mean - 1.96 * se,
      upper = mean + 1.96 * se,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Holm-corrected confirmatory contrasts for annotation (one-sided)
  sig_sub <- conf_tables[[dv_name]] %>%
    mutate(
      Group_plot = factor(str_to_title(str_remove(contrast, " - neutral")),
                          levels = desired_order),
      star    = map_chr(p_holm, sig_stars),
      est_fmt = sprintf("%.3f", estimate),
      p_fmt   = sprintf("%.3f", p_holm),
      # Delta over p on two lines: the single-line form collides between columns
      label_expr = map2(
        est_fmt, p_fmt,
        ~ bquote(
            atop(
              Delta == .( .x ),
              "(" * italic(p) == .( .y ) * ")"
            )
          )
      )
    )

  # Neutral reference: (ref.) on the Delta line; phantom second line keeps
  # the same vertical footprint as the treatment annotations.
  neutral_annot <- tibble(
    Group_plot = factor("Neutral", levels = desired_order),
    star       = "",
    # character + parse=TRUE (same path as geom_text for all panels)
    label_expr = "atop('(ref.)', phantom('(' * italic(p) == '0.000' * ')'))"
  )

  sig_sub <- bind_rows(
    neutral_annot,
    sig_sub %>%
      mutate(label_expr = map_chr(
        label_expr,
        ~ paste(deparse(.x, width.cutoff = 500L), collapse = "")
      )) %>%
      select(Group_plot, star, label_expr)
  )

  y_limits <- dv_scales[[dv_name]]

  cond_colors <- c(
    "Neutral"   = "#737373",
    "Interview" = "#1f78b4",
    "Empathy"   = "#e31a1c",
    "Roleplay"  = "#33a02c",
    "Debunking" = "#5f5f5f"
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group_plot, y = score_original, fill = Group_plot)) +
    stat_halfeye(
      side = "right", trim = TRUE, justification = -0.1,
      point_interval = NULL, scale = 0.5, alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = sum_sub,
      aes(x = Group_plot, y = mean),
      size = 2.2, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = sum_sub,
      aes(x = Group_plot, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, y = mean),
      width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_sub,
      aes(x = Group_plot, y = Inf, label = star),
      size = 5, fontface = "bold", vjust = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_sub,
      aes(x = Group_plot, y = Inf, label = label_expr),
      parse = TRUE, size = 2.9, vjust = 2.3, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Neutral"   = "NEUTRAL (ref.)",
                                "Debunking" = "DEBUNKING",
                                "Interview" = "INTERVIEW",
                                "Empathy"   = "EMPATHY",
                                "Roleplay"  = "ROLEPLAY")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = dv_plot_labels[[dv_name]]) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      breaks = dv_breaks[[dv_name]],
      # squish rather than drop: the trimmed density grid can fall a
      # floating-point hair outside the bounded response scale
      oob = scales::oob_squish,
      # extra headroom at the top for the two-line contrast annotations
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.25))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 8, 5, 8)
    )
}

stacked_conf_fu <- plot_dv_fu("DV1") / plot_dv_fu("DV2") / plot_dv_fu("DV3") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")

# The default pdf() encoding cannot render the marginal-significance dagger,
# so write the file with an encoding that contains it.
pdf_dagger <- function(filename, ...) {
  grDevices::pdf(file = filename, ..., encoding = "WinAnsi")
}

ggsave("Study3_FollowUp_Stacked_Figure.pdf", stacked_conf_fu,
       width = 10, height = 15, device = pdf_dagger)

stacked_conf_fu
```

```{r}
make_pairwise_table <- function(model, holm_family = c("six", "ten")) {
  holm_family <- match.arg(holm_family)
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Group)
  raw <- pairs(emm, adjust = "none") %>%   # two-sided raw p-values
    as.data.frame()

  if (holm_family == "six") {
    raw <- raw %>% filter(!grepl("neutral", contrast))
  }

  raw %>%
    mutate(
      estimate = round(estimate, 3),
      SE       = round(SE, 3),
      t        = round(t.ratio, 3),
      CI_low   = round(estimate - qt(0.975, df) * SE, 3),
      CI_high  = round(estimate + qt(0.975, df) * SE, 3),
      p_holm   = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"), 4),
      stars    = map_chr(p_holm, sig_stars)
    ) %>%
    select(contrast, estimate, SE, df, t, CI_low, CI_high, p_holm, stars)
}

# LaTeX export of the pairwise-comparison tables (mirrors
# save_pairwise_table_tex in Study 1/2), saved to tables/
save_pairwise_table_tex <- function(tbl, caption, label, file) {
  out <- prep_table_for_export(tbl)
  out %>%
    kable(digits = 3, caption = caption, label = label,
          format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
          escape = FALSE, col.names = export_col_names(out)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                              latex_options = "scale_down") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}
```

## Persistence: follow-up vs post estimates on the matched sample


```{r}
# Reconstruct post DVs on the matched sample
fu_no_flyer <- fu_no_flyer %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("post_attitudes"), as.numeric),
    across(starts_with("post_support"),   as.numeric),
    across(starts_with("post_policy"),    as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("post_attitudes"), ~ rescale01(., 1, 5)),
    across(starts_with("post_support"),   ~ rescale01(., 0, 100)),
    across(starts_with("post_policy"),    ~ rescale01(., 0, 100))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    DV1_perceptions_post = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("post_attitudes")), na.rm = TRUE),
    DV2_support_post     = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("post_support")),   na.rm = TRUE),
    DV3_policy_post      = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("post_policy")),    na.rm = TRUE)
  )

lm_DV1_post <- lm(DV1_perceptions_post ~ Group, data = fu_no_flyer)
lm_DV2_post <- lm(DV2_support_post     ~ Group, data = fu_no_flyer)
lm_DV3_post <- lm(DV3_policy_post      ~ Group, data = fu_no_flyer)


extract_coefs <- function(model, time_label) {
  emm  <- emmeans(model, ~ Group)
  cons <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "neutral")

  holm <- summary(cons, adjust = "holm", side = ">") %>% as.data.frame()
  ci   <- confint(cons, adjust = "none") %>% as.data.frame()
  stopifnot(identical(as.character(holm$contrast), as.character(ci$contrast)))

  tibble(
    condition = str_remove(as.character(holm$contrast), " - neutral"),
    estimate  = holm$estimate,
    SE        = holm$SE,
    df        = holm$df,
    CI_low    = ci$lower.CL,
    CI_high   = ci$upper.CL,
    p_holm    = holm$p.value,
    time      = time_label
  )
}

persistence <- bind_rows(
  extract_coefs(lm_DV1_post, "Post") %>% mutate(DV = "DV1 Perceptions"),
  extract_coefs(lm_DV1_fu,   "Follow-Up") %>% mutate(DV = "DV1 Perceptions"),
  extract_coefs(lm_DV2_post, "Post") %>% mutate(DV = "DV2 Support"),
  extract_coefs(lm_DV2_fu,   "Follow-Up") %>% mutate(DV = "DV2 Support"),
  extract_coefs(lm_DV3_post, "Post") %>% mutate(DV = "DV3 Policy"),
  extract_coefs(lm_DV3_fu,   "Follow-Up") %>% mutate(DV = "DV3 Policy")
)

persistence_wide <- persistence %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(DV, condition),
    names_from = time,
    values_from = c(estimate, SE, CI_low, CI_high, p_holm)
  )


persistence_wide %>%
  select(DV, condition,
         estimate_Post, SE_Post, p_holm_Post,
         `estimate_Follow-Up`, `SE_Follow-Up`, `p_holm_Follow-Up`) %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Treatment-vs-Neutral Estimates: Post vs Follow-Up (matched sample; one-sided Holm-corrected p within DV and time point)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

# Coefficient plot
persistence %>%
  mutate(
    time = factor(time, levels = c("Post", "Follow-Up")),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("debunking", "interview", "empathy", "roleplay"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = estimate, color = time)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = estimate - 1.96 * SE, ymax = estimate + 1.96 * SE),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ DV) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Post" = "#1f78b4", "Follow-Up" = "#33a02c")) +
  labs(
    title = "Treatment Effects vs Neutral: Post vs Two-Week Follow-Up",
    x = "", y = "Estimate vs neutral (0–1 scale, 95% CI)", color = "Time"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## Durability: post → follow-up change (Group × Time LMM)


```{r}

dur_long <- fu_no_flyer %>%
  select(PROLIFIC_PID, Group,
         DV1_Post = DV1_perceptions_post, DV1_FollowUp = DV1_perceptions_fu,
         DV2_Post = DV2_support_post,     DV2_FollowUp = DV2_support_fu,
         DV3_Post = DV3_policy_post,      DV3_FollowUp = DV3_policy_fu) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(PROLIFIC_PID, Group), names_to = c("DV", "time"), names_sep = "_",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(time  = factor(time, levels = c("Post", "FollowUp")),
         Group = relevel(factor(Group), ref = "neutral"))

stopifnot(nrow(fu_no_flyer) == 444)
stopifnot(nrow(dur_long) == 444 * 3 * 2)
stopifnot(!any(is.na(dur_long$score)))

fit_dur_lmm <- function(dv_name) {
  lmer(score ~ Group * time + (1 | PROLIFIC_PID),
       data = filter(dur_long, DV == dv_name))
}

lmm_DV1_dur <- fit_dur_lmm("DV1")
lmm_DV2_dur <- fit_dur_lmm("DV2")
lmm_DV3_dur <- fit_dur_lmm("DV3")


check_lmm_identity <- function(lmm, lm_post, lm_fu) {
  b <- lme4::fixef(lmm)
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(b[["Grouproleplay"]]),
                             unname(coef(lm_post)[["Grouproleplay"]]),
                             tolerance = 1e-6)))
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(b[["Grouproleplay"]] + b[["Grouproleplay:timeFollowUp"]]),
                             unname(coef(lm_fu)[["Grouproleplay"]]),
                             tolerance = 1e-6)))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

check_lmm_identity(lmm_DV1_dur, lm_DV1_post, lm_DV1_fu)
check_lmm_identity(lmm_DV2_dur, lm_DV2_post, lm_DV2_fu)
check_lmm_identity(lmm_DV3_dur, lm_DV3_post, lm_DV3_fu)

# Canonical DV labels for the durability tables. The "(Follow-Up)" suffix used
# elsewhere in this document would be misleading here, because these rows span
# both time points.
dv_labels_dur <- c(DV1 = "Perceptions",
                   DV2 = "Refugee Support",
                   DV3 = "Policy Endorsement")

make_omnibus_row <- function(lmm, dv_key) {
  a <- as.data.frame(anova(lmm))
  stopifnot("Group:time" %in% rownames(a))
  r <- a["Group:time", ]
  tibble(
    DV    = unname(dv_labels_dur[[dv_key]]),
    F     = round(r[["F value"]], 3),
    NumDF = r[["NumDF"]],
    DenDF = round(r[["DenDF"]], 1),
    p     = round(r[["Pr(>F)"]], 4)
  )
}

dur_omnibus <- bind_rows(
  make_omnibus_row(lmm_DV1_dur, "DV1"),
  make_omnibus_row(lmm_DV2_dur, "DV2"),
  make_omnibus_row(lmm_DV3_dur, "DV3")
)

dur_omnibus %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Omnibus Group x Time Test of Durability (matched sample, n = 444)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

# LaTeX version for export (same "_kbl" + save_kable pattern used throughout
# this document), saved to tables/
study3_durability_omnibus_kbl <- dur_omnibus %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Study 3: test of the Condition $\\times$ Time interaction as a whole, for durability from immediate post-intervention to the two-week follow-up (Satterthwaite denominator degrees of freedom; matched sample, n = 444).",
        label = "s3-dur-omnibus",
        col.names = c("DV", "$F$", "NumDF", "DenDF", "$p$"),
        format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

kableExtra::save_kable(
  study3_durability_omnibus_kbl,
  file = "tables/study3_durability_omnibus.tex"
)


make_change_rows <- function(lmm, key) {
  broom.mixed::tidy(lmm, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "^Group.+:timeFollowUp$")) %>%
    transmute(
      dv_key    = key,
      DV        = unname(dv_labels_dur[[key]]),
      condition = str_remove(str_remove(term, "^Group"), ":timeFollowUp$"),
      estimate  = estimate,
      SE        = std.error,
      df        = df,
      t         = statistic,
      CI_low    = conf.low,
      CI_high   = conf.high,
      p_holm    = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm")
    )
}

dur_change_raw <- bind_rows(
  make_change_rows(lmm_DV1_dur, "DV1"),
  make_change_rows(lmm_DV2_dur, "DV2"),
  make_change_rows(lmm_DV3_dur, "DV3")
)

stopifnot(nrow(dur_change_raw) == 12)

dur_post_fu <- persistence_wide %>%
  transmute(dv_key  = str_extract(DV, "^DV[0-9]"),
            condition,
            post_est = estimate_Post,          post_se = SE_Post,
            post_p   = p_holm_Post,
            fu_est   = `estimate_Follow-Up`,   fu_se   = `SE_Follow-Up`,
            fu_p     = `p_holm_Follow-Up`)

dur_change_full <- dur_change_raw %>%
  left_join(dur_post_fu, by = c("dv_key", "condition"))

stopifnot(!any(is.na(dur_change_full$post_est)), !any(is.na(dur_change_full$fu_est)))
stopifnot(all(abs((dur_change_full$fu_est - dur_change_full$post_est) -
                    dur_change_full$estimate) < 1e-6))

dur_change <- dur_change_full %>%
  transmute(
    DV,
    Contrast = paste(condition, "- neutral"),
    Post     = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", post_est, post_se),
    p_post   = round(post_p, 4),
    FollowUp = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", fu_est, fu_se),
    p_fu     = round(fu_p, 4),
    Estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    SE       = round(SE, 3),
    df       = round(df, 1),
    t        = round(t, 3),
    CI_low   = round(CI_low, 3),
    CI_high  = round(CI_high, 3),
    p_holm   = round(p_holm, 4),
    stars    = map_chr(p_holm, sig_stars)
  )

dur_change %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        col.names = c("DV", "Contrast",
                      "b (SE)", "p Holm (one-sided)",
                      "b (SE)", "p Holm (one-sided)",
                      "Delta", "SE", "df", "t", "CI low", "CI high",
                      "p Holm (two-sided)", "Sig."),
        caption = "Treatment-vs-Neutral Differences at Post and Follow-Up, and their Change (Group x Time coefficients; matched sample, n = 444)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Post" = 2, "Follow-up" = 2,
                     "Change: Follow-up - Post (Group x Time)" = 8))

# LaTeX export. Column headers carry no underscores and are written in math
# mode (escape = FALSE), matching the sensitivity tables further below.
dur_change_export <- dur_change %>%
  mutate(
    Contrast = sprintf("%s $-$ \\textsc{Neutral}",
                       unname(group_display_labels[str_remove(Contrast, " - neutral")])),
    across(c(p_post, p_fu, p_holm), fmt_p)
  )

stopifnot(!any(is.na(dur_change_export$Contrast)))

study3_durability_change_kbl <- dur_change_export %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Study 3: treatment-vs-\\textsc{Neutral} differences at immediate post-intervention and at the two-week follow-up, and the change between them (Group $\\times$ Time coefficients). Post and follow-up $p$-values are one-sided and Holm-corrected across the four contrasts within outcome and time point; change $p$-values are two-sided and Holm-corrected within outcome; Sig.\\ refers to the change; 95\\% confidence intervals unadjusted; matched sample, n = 444.",
        label = "s3-dur-change",
        col.names = c("DV", "Contrast",
                      "$b$ (SE)", "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm}}$",

                      "$\\Delta$", "SE", "$df$", "$t$",

        format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                            latex_options = "scale_down") %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Post" = 2, "Follow-up" = 2,
                                 "Change (Follow-up $-$ Post)" = 8),
                               escape = FALSE)

kableExtra::save_kable(
  study3_durability_change_kbl,

# Within-person post-follow-up correlation implied by the random intercept.
lmm_icc <- function(lmm) {
  vc    <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(lmm))
  var_u <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "PROLIFIC_PID"]
  var_e <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]
  var_u / (var_u + var_e)
}

icc_DV1_dur <- lmm_icc(lmm_DV1_dur)
icc_DV2_dur <- lmm_icc(lmm_DV2_dur)
icc_DV3_dur <- lmm_icc(lmm_DV3_dur)

cat(sprintf("ICC (within-person post/follow-up correlation): DV1 = %.3f, DV2 = %.3f, DV3 = %.3f\n",
            icc_DV1_dur, icc_DV2_dur, icc_DV3_dur))
```

```{r}
format_persistence_dv <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    arrange(match(condition, c("debunking", "interview", "empathy", "roleplay"))) %>%
    transmute(
      Contrast = paste(condition, "- neutral"),
      b_post   = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", estimate_Post, SE_Post),
      # p-values stay numeric here so the HTML view and the LaTeX export can
      # format them differently (plain %.3f vs fmt_p()'s "$<$0.001").
      p_post   = p_holm_Post,
      b_fu     = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", `estimate_Follow-Up`, `SE_Follow-Up`),
      p_fu     = `p_holm_Follow-Up`,
      delta    = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", change_est, change_lo, change_hi),
      p_delta  = change_p
    )
}

persistence_p_columns <- c("p_post", "p_fu", "p_delta")

persistence_col_names <- c(
  "Contrast",
  "$b_{\\mathrm{post}}$ (SE)", "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm,post}}$",
  "$b_{\\mathrm{FU}}$ (SE)",   "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm,FU}}$",
  "$\\Delta$ [95\\% CI]",      "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm},\\Delta}$"
)


persistence_caption <- function(dv_label) {

    "post-intervention and at the two-week follow-up, and the change between ",
    "them ($p$ one-sided and Holm-corrected within time point for the post and ",
    "follow-up columns, two-sided and Holm-corrected for the change column; ",
    "confidence intervals unadjusted; matched sample, n = 444; post estimates ",
    "therefore differ slightly from the full-sample primary analysis ",
    "(Section H.2))."), dv_label)
}

}
```

```{r}

pretty_group_name <- c(
  neutral   = "Neutral",
  debunking = "Debunking",
  interview = "Interview",
  empathy   = "Empathy",
  roleplay  = "Roleplay"
)

manuscript_pairs_order <- list(
  c("roleplay",  "interview"),  # Roleplay vs Interview
  c("roleplay",  "empathy"),    # Roleplay vs Empathy
  c("roleplay",  "debunking"),  # Roleplay vs Debunking
  c("empathy",   "interview"),  # Empathy vs Interview
  c("empathy",   "debunking"),  # Empathy vs Debunking
  c("interview", "debunking")   # Interview vs Debunking
)

extract_pair_row <- function(tbl, A, B) {
  cand_AB <- paste(A, "-", B)
  cand_BA <- paste(B, "-", A)
  row <- tbl %>% filter(contrast %in% c(cand_AB, cand_BA))
  stopifnot(nrow(row) == 1)
  flip <- row$contrast[1] == cand_BA
  if (flip) {
    new_low  <- -row$CI_high
    new_high <- -row$CI_low
    row$estimate <- -row$estimate
    row$CI_low   <- new_low
    row$CI_high  <- new_high
  }
  row %>%
    mutate(Contrast = paste(pretty_group_name[[A]], "vs", pretty_group_name[[B]])) %>%
    select(Contrast, estimate, CI_low, CI_high, p_holm)
}

manuscript_summary <- function(tbl, dv_label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(manuscript_pairs_order, ~ extract_pair_row(tbl, .x[1], .x[2])) %>%
    mutate(DV = dv_label, .before = 1)
}

format_manuscript_table <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      `Estimate (p.p.)` = sprintf("%.1f", estimate * 100),
      `95% CI (p.p.)`    = sprintf("[%.1f, %.1f]", CI_low * 100, CI_high * 100),
      p_holm             = sprintf("%.3f", p_holm)
    ) %>%
    select(DV, Contrast, `Estimate (p.p.)`, `95% CI (p.p.)`, p_holm)
}

cat("\n=== Manuscript-ready summary: six-pair intervention-vs-intervention contrasts (Follow-Up) ===\n")
manuscript_table_fu <- bind_rows(
  manuscript_summary(tbl_DV1_pairwise_fu, "Perceptions"),
  manuscript_summary(tbl_DV2_pairwise_fu, "Refugee Support"),
  manuscript_summary(tbl_DV3_pairwise_fu, "Policy Endorsement")
) %>% format_manuscript_table()
print(as.data.frame(manuscript_table_fu))

cat("\n=== Manuscript-ready summary: six-pair intervention-vs-intervention contrasts (Immediate Post) ===\n")

  manuscript_summary(tbl_DV1_pairwise_post, "Perceptions"),
  manuscript_summary(tbl_DV2_pairwise_post, "Refugee Support"),
  manuscript_summary(tbl_DV3_pairwise_post, "Policy Endorsement")
) %>% format_manuscript_table()
print(as.data.frame(manuscript_table_post))
```


# Immediate post-intervention analysis (preregistered primary; full sample)

Everything above is conditioned on returning for the follow-up. The pre-registration, however, designates the **immediate post-intervention measurement as the primary outcome** (H1–H3: treatment > neutral) and assigns the follow-up the narrower role of assessing the durability of those effects. This section therefore reports the pre-registered primary analysis on all chatbot participants, not only on the subset who came back two weeks later.

The specification is the pre-registered one and is identical to the confirmatory follow-up analysis in every respect except the outcome and the sample: one OLS model per DV with neutral as the reference category, treatment-vs-neutral contrasts tested one-sided (H1–H3 are directional) and Holm-corrected within each DV across the four contrasts. The static-flyer condition is held out, as in the pre-registration. The section is placed here, rather than at the top of the document, so that it can reuse the helpers defined above and compare itself against the matched-sample estimates already in memory.

```{r}
# `attrition` was built from main_clean in the "Attrition Check" section and
# already carries DV1_post/DV2_post/DV3_post, constructed from the post_* items
# with rescale01() exactly as the follow-up DVs are. main_clean is the
# main-study sample cleaned in the Data Import chunk of this document, so the
# immediate-post models below use the same construction as the follow-up ones.
post_full <- attrition %>%
  filter(Group != "flyer") %>%
  mutate(Group = relevel(factor(Group), ref = "neutral"))

# 465 = the 554 cleaned main-study participants minus the 89 assigned to the
# static-flyer condition, which had no chatbot interaction.
stopifnot(nrow(post_full) == 465)
stopifnot(!any(is.na(post_full$DV1_post)),
          !any(is.na(post_full$DV2_post)),
          !any(is.na(post_full$DV3_post)))

lm_DV1_post_full <- lm(DV1_post ~ Group, data = post_full)
lm_DV2_post_full <- lm(DV2_post ~ Group, data = post_full)
lm_DV3_post_full <- lm(DV3_post ~ Group, data = post_full)

cat("===== DV1: Perceptions (immediate post, full sample) =====\n")
print(summary(lm_DV1_post_full))
print(anova(lm_DV1_post_full))

cat("\n===== DV2: Refugee Support (immediate post, full sample) =====\n")
print(summary(lm_DV2_post_full))
print(anova(lm_DV2_post_full))

cat("\n===== DV3: Policy Endorsement (immediate post, full sample) =====\n")
print(summary(lm_DV3_post_full))
print(anova(lm_DV3_post_full))
```

```{r}
save_confirmatory_table_tex(contr_DV2_post_full, post_full_caption("Refugee support",    lm_DV2_post_full), "s3-post-dv2", "tables/study3_post_dv2_contrasts.tex")
save_confirmatory_table_tex(contr_DV3_post_full, post_full_caption("Policy endorsement", lm_DV3_post_full), "s3-post-dv3", "tables/study3_post_dv3_contrasts.tex")
```

## Pairwise contrasts among interventions (exploratory)

```{r}
# Reuses make_pairwise_table() with the same six-pair Holm family used for the
```

## Cross-checks

A reporting comparison against the matched-sample immediate-post models: those are expected to differ, because they are fitted on the 444 participants who returned, and the point is to show how much.

```{r}
# Alignment with the matched-sample immediate-post models fitted earlier in
# this document. These are the same contrasts on the 444 returners, so they
# are expected to differ; this is a reporting check, not an equality check.
matched_post_tables <- list(DV1 = contr_DV1_post,
                            DV2 = contr_DV2_post,
                            DV3 = contr_DV3_post)

align_post <- function(full_tbl, matched_tbl, dv_label) {
  full_tbl %>%
    select(contrast, b_full = estimate, p_full = p_holm) %>%
    left_join(matched_tbl %>% select(contrast, b_matched = estimate, p_matched = p_holm),
              by = "contrast") %>%
    mutate(DV = dv_label, diff = round(b_full - b_matched, 3), .before = 1)
}

post_sample_alignment <- bind_rows(
  align_post(contr_DV1_post_full, contr_DV1_post, "Perceptions"),
  align_post(contr_DV2_post_full, contr_DV2_post, "Refugee Support"),
  align_post(contr_DV3_post_full, contr_DV3_post, "Policy Endorsement")
)

cat("\n=== Alignment: full sample (n = 465) vs matched follow-up sample (n = 444), immediate post ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(post_sample_alignment))

post_sample_alignment %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Immediate Post-Intervention Contrasts: Full Sample (n = 465) vs Matched Follow-Up Sample (n = 444)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=15}
dur_order <- c("Neutral", "Debunking", "Interview", "Empathy", "Roleplay")

plot_data_dur <- dur_long %>%
  mutate(
    score_original = case_when(
      DV == "DV1" ~ score * 4 + 1,      # 0-1 -> 1-5
      DV == "DV2" ~ score * 100,        # 0-1 -> 0-100
      DV == "DV3" ~ score * 100,        # 0-1 -> 0-100
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    time_plot  = factor(ifelse(time == "Post", "Post", "Follow-up"),
                        levels = c("Post", "Follow-up")),
    Group_plot = factor(str_to_title(Group), levels = dur_order)
  )

# Neutral is the reference category, which the facet strip states explicitly.
dur_facet_labels <- c("Neutral"   = "NEUTRAL (ref.)",
                      "Debunking" = "DEBUNKING",
                      "Interview" = "INTERVIEW",
                      "Empathy"   = "EMPATHY",
                      "Roleplay"  = "ROLEPLAY")

# No "(Follow-Up)" suffix here: these panels span both time points.
dur_plot_labels <- list(DV1 = "Perceptions",
                        DV2 = "Refugee Support",
                        DV3 = "Policy Endorsement")

# One annotation per treatment facet: the confirmatory follow-up contrast
# (one-sided Holm). conf_tables is the list of contr_DV#_fu built for the
# follow-up-only figure above.
dur_annotation <- function(dv_name) {
  treat <- conf_tables[[dv_name]] %>%
    transmute(condition = str_remove(contrast, " - neutral"),
              b_fu = estimate, p_fu = p_holm) %>%
    mutate(
      Group_plot = factor(str_to_title(condition), levels = dur_order),
      star       = map_chr(p_fu, sig_stars),
      label_expr = map2_chr(
        b_fu, p_fu,
        ~ paste(deparse(
            bquote(atop(
              Delta == .(sprintf("%.3f", .x)),
              "(" * italic(p) == .(sprintf("%.3f", .y)) * ")"
            )),
            width.cutoff = 500L
          ), collapse = "")
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Group_plot, star, label_expr)

  # Neutral reference: "(ref.)" on the first line, phantom second line so the
  # annotation occupies the same footprint as the treatment facets.
  neutral <- tibble(
    Group_plot = factor("Neutral", levels = dur_order),
    star       = "",
    label_expr = "atop('(ref.)', phantom('(' * italic(p) == '0.000' * ')'))"
  )

  bind_rows(neutral, treat)
}

plot_dv_dur <- function(dv_name) {

  df <- plot_data_dur %>% filter(DV == dv_name)

  sum_sub <- df %>%
    group_by(Group_plot, time_plot) %>%
    summarise(
      mean  = mean(score_original),
      sd    = sd(score_original),
      n     = n(),
      se    = sd / sqrt(n),
      lower = mean - 1.96 * se,
      upper = mean + 1.96 * se,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  sig_sub <- dur_annotation(dv_name)

  # Facet strip: condition name with the follow-up n beneath it.
  n_fu <- sum_sub %>% filter(time_plot == "Follow-up")
  strip_labels <- setNames(
    sprintf("%s\nFollow-up: n = %d",
            dur_facet_labels[as.character(n_fu$Group_plot)], n_fu$n),
    as.character(n_fu$Group_plot)
  )

  # Same palette as plot_dv_fu() above; that function keeps it local, so it is
  # restated here rather than reached into.
  cond_colors_dur <- c(
    "Neutral"   = "#737373",
    "Interview" = "#1f78b4",
    "Empathy"   = "#e31a1c",
    "Roleplay"  = "#33a02c",
    "Debunking" = "#5f5f5f"
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = time_plot, y = score_original, fill = Group_plot)) +
    stat_halfeye(
      data = ~ filter(.x, time_plot == "Post"),
      side = "left", trim = TRUE, justification = 1.05,
      point_interval = NULL, scale = 0.38, alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    stat_halfeye(
      data = ~ filter(.x, time_plot == "Follow-up"),
      side = "right", trim = TRUE, justification = -0.05,
      point_interval = NULL, scale = 0.38, alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = sum_sub, aes(x = time_plot, y = mean, group = 1),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = sum_sub, aes(x = time_plot, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
      width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = sum_sub, aes(x = time_plot, y = mean),
      size = 2.2, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_sub, aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = star),
      size = 6.5, fontface = "bold", vjust = 1.05, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_sub, aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label_expr),
      parse = TRUE, size = 4.7, vjust = 2.1, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Group_plot, nrow = 1,
               labeller = labeller(Group_plot = strip_labels)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors_dur) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = dur_plot_labels[[dv_name]]) +
    # Extra horizontal room so the outward-facing half-eyes are not clipped at
    # the facet edges.
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.75)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = dv_scales[[dv_name]],
      breaks = dv_breaks[[dv_name]],
      oob    = scales::oob_squish,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.45))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "none",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing    = unit(0.9, "lines"),
      plot.margin      = margin(12, 8, 5, 8)
    )
}
```

```{r}
summary_rows <- function(key) {
  dv_label <- unname(post_full_labels[[key]])
  om       <- dur_omnibus %>% filter(DV == dv_label)
  stopifnot(nrow(om) == 1)

  post_full_tables[[key]] %>%
    transmute(condition = str_remove(contrast, " - neutral"),
              b_post = estimate, se_post = SE, p_post = p_holm) %>%
    left_join(
      cohens_d_table_post_full %>%
        filter(DV == dv_label) %>%
        select(condition, d = effect_size),
      by = "condition"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      conf_tables[[key]] %>%
        transmute(condition = str_remove(contrast, " - neutral"),
                  b_fu = estimate, se_fu = SE, p_fu = p_holm),
      by = "condition"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      cohens_d_table_fu %>%
        filter(DV == dv_label) %>%
        select(condition, d_fu = effect_size),
      by = "condition"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      dur_change_raw %>%
        filter(dv_key == key) %>%
        select(condition, ch = estimate, ch_lo = CI_low, ch_hi = CI_high, ch_p = p_holm),
      by = "condition"
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(condition, c("debunking", "interview", "empathy", "roleplay"))) %>%
    transmute(
      DV                   = dv_label,
      Condition            = unname(pretty_group_name[condition]),
      `Post b (p.p.)`      = sprintf("%.1f", b_post * 100),
      `Post SE (p.p.)`     = sprintf("%.1f", se_post * 100),
      `Post p Holm`        = sprintf("%.3f", p_post),
      `Post d`             = sprintf("%.3f", d),
      `FU b (p.p.)`        = sprintf("%.1f", b_fu * 100),
      `FU SE (p.p.)`       = sprintf("%.1f", se_fu * 100),
      `FU p Holm`          = sprintf("%.3f", p_fu),
      `FU d`               = sprintf("%.3f", d_fu),
      `Change (p.p.)`      = sprintf("%.1f", ch * 100),
      `Change 95% CI`      = sprintf("[%.1f, %.1f]", ch_lo * 100, ch_hi * 100),
      `Change p Holm`      = sprintf("%.3f", ch_p),
      `Omnibus Group:Time` = sprintf("F(%d, %.1f) = %.2f, p = %.3f",
                                     as.integer(om$NumDF), om$DenDF, om$F, om$p)
    )
}
```

# Exploratory robustness: engagement-controlled models


```{r exploratory-engagement-robustness-fu, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)


one_sided_p <- function(p_two, estimate) {
  ifelse(estimate > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - p_two / 2)
}

# 1. LOAD CHATBOT LOG
# Path is relative to the Rmd's working directory (study_3/analysis/).
chat_log <- readxl::read_excel("../data/Chatbot_data_collection_Jan23_2026.xlsx")

if (!inherits(chat_log$timestamp, "POSIXct")) {
  chat_log$timestamp <- lubridate::ymd_hms(chat_log$timestamp, quiet = TRUE)
}

# 2. PER-PARTICIPANT ENGAGEMENT
# The chatbot log uses the raw condition labels ("flyer"), so we filter on
# those strings here.
system_markers <- c("Flyer content shown", "Flyer completed", "")


is_system_prompt <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\s*You are a", x) & nchar(x) > 1000
}

# The filtered log is kept as its own object so the log-integrity figures
# quoted in Supplement E.2 are computed from it rather than typed.
chat_log_fu <- chat_log %>%
  filter(condition != "flyer",
         !is.na(prolific_pid), prolific_pid != "",
         !is.na(user_message), !user_message %in% system_markers)

n_system_prompt_rows <- sum(is_system_prompt(chat_log_fu$user_message))

engagement_sessions <- chat_log_fu %>%
  group_by(prolific_pid, session_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sess_turns  = sum(!is_system_prompt(user_message)),
    sess_rows   = n(),
    # The opening system-prompt row is written unconditionally once per
    # session, so its absence means that write was lost, not that the
    # participant behaved differently.
    sess_opener = any(is_system_prompt(user_message)),
    sess_duration = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                        min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                        units = "mins")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # A single surviving row spans no interval, so duration is unknown rather
  # than zero; keeping the 0 would score a dropped write as minimal engagement.
  mutate(sess_duration = if_else(sess_rows > 1, sess_duration, NA_real_))

engagement <- engagement_sessions %>%
  group_by(prolific_pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_turns           = sum(sess_turns),
    chat_duration_min = if (all(is.na(sess_duration))) NA_real_
                        else sum(sess_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Engagement is only a verifiable dose if every session opener survived
    # and every session yielded a usable interval.
    log_complete      = all(sess_opener) & !any(is.na(sess_duration)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(PROLIFIC_PID = prolific_pid) %>%
  mutate(
    # Zero recorded turns = only the opener survived, i.e. the participant's own
    # messages were lost; treat as missing in the sensitivity versions below.
    n_turns_nz      = ifelse(n_turns > 0, n_turns, NA_real_)
  )

n_sessions_logged        <- nrow(engagement_sessions)
n_sessions_with_turns    <- sum(engagement_sessions$sess_turns > 0)
n_sessions_missing_open  <- sum(engagement_sessions$sess_turns > 0 &
                                  !engagement_sessions$sess_opener)
turns_duration_r         <- cor(engagement$n_turns, engagement$chat_duration_min,
                                use = "complete.obs")
n_turns_duration_pairs   <- sum(!is.na(engagement$n_turns) &
                                  !is.na(engagement$chat_duration_min))

cat(sprintf(
  paste0("Chatbot log integrity (non-flyer sessions):\n",
         "  system-prompt rows removed from the turn counts: %d\n",
         "  sessions with at least one later turn: %d of %d logged sessions\n",
         "  ... of those, opening system-prompt row missing: %d\n",
         "  correlation between recorded turns and recorded duration: r = %.3f (n = %d participants)\n"),
  n_system_prompt_rows, n_sessions_with_turns, n_sessions_logged,
  n_sessions_missing_open, turns_duration_r, n_turns_duration_pairs))

# 3. ENGAGEMENT DESCRIPTIVES BY CONDITION (follow-up analysis sample)
fu_no_flyer_eng <- fu_no_flyer %>%
  left_join(engagement, by = "PROLIFIC_PID")

# 3b. LOG COVERAGE

log_coverage_fu <- fu_no_flyer_eng %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    no_log       = sum(is.na(n_turns)),
    opener_only  = sum(!is.na(n_turns) & n_turns == 0),               # opener row survived, no later turn
    partial_log  = sum(!is.na(n_turns) & n_turns > 0 & !log_complete),
    complete_log = sum(!is.na(n_turns) & log_complete),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
stopifnot(all(log_coverage_fu$no_log + log_coverage_fu$opener_only + log_coverage_fu$partial_log + log_coverage_fu$complete_log == log_coverage_fu$n))

log_coverage_fu %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Condition", "$n$", "No log rows", "Opener row only (0 turns)",
                      "Partial log ($\\geq$1 turn)", "Complete log"),
        caption = "Chatbot log coverage by condition (follow-up sample). Rows were lost to Google Sheets write failures during high-concurrency recruitment, so engagement is only partially observed; the sensitivity refit in step 7 restricts to participants with complete logs.") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")


study3_followup_log_coverage_kbl <- log_coverage_fu %>%
  mutate(Group = relabel_groups_in_string(as.character(Group))) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Condition", "$n$", "No log rows", "Opener row only (0 turns)",
                      "Partial log ($\\geq$1 turn)", "Complete log"),
        # Explicit label: every kable in this chunk would otherwise inherit the
        # chunk name and LaTeX would see multiply defined labels.
        label = "supp_s3_log_coverage",
        caption = "Study 3: chatbot log coverage by condition (follow-up sample, n = 444). Rows were lost to Google Sheets write failures during high-concurrency recruitment, so recorded engagement is a lower bound; the dose-response sensitivity refit is restricted to the complete-log column.",
        format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

kableExtra::save_kable(
  study3_followup_log_coverage_kbl,
  file = "tables/study3_followup_engagement_log_coverage.tex"
)

engagement_desc_fu <- fu_no_flyer_eng %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    # The denominators behind the means: how many participants contributed any
    # log row at all, and how many contributed a verifiably complete log.
    n_log          = sum(!is.na(n_turns)),
    n_complete     = sum(!is.na(n_turns) & log_complete),
    n_turns_mean   = mean(n_turns,           na.rm = TRUE),
    n_turns_sd     = sd(n_turns,             na.rm = TRUE),
    n_turns_med    = median(n_turns,         na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_mean  = mean(chat_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_sd    = sd(chat_duration_min,   na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_med   = median(chat_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

engagement_desc_fu %>%
  kable(digits = 2,
        caption = "Chatbot Engagement by Condition at the Intervention Session (Follow-Up Sample; Flyer Held Out — participants in that condition did not interact with a chatbot)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

# LaTeX version for export (same "_kbl" + save_kable pattern used throughout
# this document), saved to tables/.
study3_followup_engagement_desc_kbl <- engagement_desc_fu %>%
  mutate(Group = relabel_groups_in_string(as.character(Group))) %>%
  kable(digits = 2,
        col.names = c("Condition", "$n$", "$n$ with log", "$n$ complete log",
                      "Turns: mean", "Turns: SD", "Turns: median",
                      "Duration: mean", "Duration: SD", "Duration: median"),
        label = "supp_s3_engagement_desc",
        caption = "Study 3: recorded chatbot engagement by condition at the intervention session (follow-up sample, n = 444; \\textsc{Flyer} held out because those participants did not interact with a chatbot). Means and medians are computed over the participants with log rows, so they describe recorded engagement, a lower bound on actual engagement.",
        format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                            latex_options = "scale_down")

kableExtra::save_kable(
  study3_followup_engagement_desc_kbl,
  file = "tables/study3_followup_engagement_descriptives.tex"
)
```

```{r engagement-summary-stats}

ENG_DATA <- fu_no_flyer_eng          # Studies 1-2: data_treatments_eng

engagement_summary_stats <- function(df, study_num) {
  logged   <- dplyr::filter(df, !is.na(n_turns))
  with_dur <- dplyr::filter(logged, !is.na(chat_duration_min))
  stopifnot(nrow(logged) > 0, nrow(with_dur) > 0, nlevels(droplevels(factor(logged$Group))) > 1)

  # Classical one-way ANOVAs, as described in the supplement (anova(lm()) has
  # clean row names; summary(aov()) pads them with spaces).
  a_turns <- anova(lm(n_turns ~ Group, data = logged))
  a_dur   <- anova(lm(chat_duration_min ~ Group, data = with_dur))
  # Sensitivity: zero recorded turns means only the opener survived, so the
  # participant's own messages were lost; refit the turns ANOVA without them.
  a_turns_nz <- anova(lm(n_turns ~ Group, data = dplyr::filter(logged, n_turns > 0)))
  # Distribution-robust companions: recorded turns are zero-inflated (lost
  # writes) and durations are right-skewed with unequal variances (Table 20).
  w_turns  <- oneway.test(n_turns ~ Group, data = logged)
  w_dur    <- oneway.test(chat_duration_min ~ Group, data = with_dur)
  kw_turns <- kruskal.test(n_turns ~ Group, data = logged)
  kw_dur   <- kruskal.test(chat_duration_min ~ Group, data = with_dur)

  by_cond <- logged %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_turns = mean(n_turns),
                     mean_dur   = mean(chat_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  tibble::tibble(
    study = study_num,
    n_chatbot = nrow(df), n_logged = nrow(logged),
    n_zero_turns = sum(logged$n_turns == 0),
    n_nonzero = sum(logged$n_turns > 0),
    n_duration = nrow(with_dur), n_complete = sum(logged$log_complete),
    turns_F = a_turns["Group", "F value"], turns_df1 = a_turns["Group", "Df"],
    turns_df2 = a_turns["Residuals", "Df"], turns_p = a_turns["Group", "Pr(>F)"],
    turns_nz_F = a_turns_nz["Group", "F value"], turns_nz_df2 = a_turns_nz["Residuals", "Df"], turns_nz_p = a_turns_nz["Group", "Pr(>F)"],
    dur_F = a_dur["Group", "F value"], dur_df1 = a_dur["Group", "Df"],
    dur_df2 = a_dur["Residuals", "Df"], dur_p = a_dur["Group", "Pr(>F)"],
    turns_welch_F = unname(w_turns$statistic), turns_welch_df2 = unname(w_turns$parameter[2]),
    turns_welch_p = w_turns$p.value,
    dur_welch_F = unname(w_dur$statistic), dur_welch_df2 = unname(w_dur$parameter[2]),
    dur_welch_p = w_dur$p.value,
    turns_kw_chisq = unname(kw_turns$statistic), turns_kw_p = kw_turns$p.value,
    dur_kw_chisq = unname(kw_dur$statistic), dur_kw_p = kw_dur$p.value,
    r_pearson  = cor(with_dur$n_turns, with_dur$chat_duration_min),
    r_spearman = cor(with_dur$n_turns, with_dur$chat_duration_min, method = "spearman"),
    mean_turns_all_logged   = mean(logged$n_turns),
    median_turns_all_logged = median(logged$n_turns),
    mean_turns_complete     = mean(logged$n_turns[logged$log_complete]),
    mean_turns_partial      = mean(logged$n_turns[!logged$log_complete]),
    mean_turns_nonzero      = mean(logged$n_turns[logged$n_turns > 0]),
    most_turns_condition    = as.character(by_cond$Group[which.max(by_cond$mean_turns)]),
    fewest_turns_condition  = as.character(by_cond$Group[which.min(by_cond$mean_turns)]),
    longest_condition       = as.character(by_cond$Group[which.max(by_cond$mean_dur)])
  )
}
```

```{r exploratory-engagement-robustness-fu-2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
eng_measures <- c(chat_duration_z = "chat_duration_min")

standardise_eng_fu <- function(data, eng_var) {
  raw_var <- eng_measures[[eng_var]]
  d <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[raw_var]]))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(d$PROLIFIC_PID))     # one row, hence one value, per participant
  d[[eng_var]] <- as.numeric(scale(d[[raw_var]]))
  d
}

fit_eng_lm_fu <- function(dv_var, eng_var, data = fu_no_flyer_eng) {
  d <- standardise_eng_fu(data, eng_var)
  f <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ Group + %s", dv_var, eng_var))
  lm(f, data = d)
}


fit_primary_lm_fu_sub <- function(dv_var, eng_var, data = fu_no_flyer_eng) {
  d <- standardise_eng_fu(data, eng_var)
  lm(as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ Group", dv_var)), data = d)
}

  fr <- model.frame(m)
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(mean(fr[[eng_var]]), 0, tolerance = 1e-8)),
            isTRUE(all.equal(sd(fr[[eng_var]]),   1, tolerance = 1e-8)),
            all(c(eng_var, "Groupdebunking", "Groupinterview", "Groupempathy", "Grouproleplay") %in% names(coef(m))))

}

eng_control_labels <- c(chat_duration_z = "Chat Duration (z)")

# Canonical DV labels reused throughout this document
# (mirrors dv_labels in Study 1/2).
dv_labels_fu <- list(
  DV1 = "Perceptions (Follow-Up)",
  DV2 = "Refugee Support (Follow-Up)",
  DV3 = "Policy Endorsement (Follow-Up)"
)


eng_contrasts_fu <- function(model, dv_name, eng_var = NULL) {
  cons <- contrast(emmeans(model, ~ Group),
                   method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "neutral")

  ci <- confint(cons, adjust = "none", level = 0.95) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(Term = as.character(contrast), CI_low = lower.CL, CI_high = upper.CL)

  intervention_rows <- summary(cons, adjust = "none", side = ">") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(
      Row              = "Intervention vs Neutral (at avg engagement)",
      Term             = as.character(contrast),
      Estimate         = estimate,
      SE               = SE,
      t                = t.ratio,
      p_one_raw        = p.value,
      p_holm_within_dv = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm")
    ) %>%
    left_join(ci, by = "Term")

  dose_row <- if (is.null(eng_var)) NULL else
    broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      filter(term == eng_var) %>%
      transmute(
        Row              = "Dose-response: Engagement",
        Term             = unname(eng_control_labels[eng_var]),
        Estimate         = estimate,
        SE               = std.error,
        t                = statistic,
        p_one_raw        = one_sided_p(p.value, estimate),
        p_holm_within_dv = NA_real_,
        CI_low           = conf.low,
        CI_high          = conf.high
      )

  bind_rows(intervention_rows, dose_row) %>%
    transmute(
      DV               = dv_labels_fu[[dv_name]],
      Eng_control      = if (is.null(eng_var)) "None (primary model)" else unname(eng_control_labels[eng_var]),
      Row, Term,
      Estimate         = round(Estimate, 3),
      SE               = round(SE, 3),
      t                = round(t, 3),
      CI_low           = round(CI_low, 3),
      CI_high          = round(CI_high, 3),
      p_one_sided      = round(p_one_raw, 4),
      p_holm_within_dv = round(p_holm_within_dv, 4)
    )
}

eng_tbl_dur_fu <- bind_rows(
  eng_contrasts_fu(lm_DV1_dur_fu, "DV1", "chat_duration_z"),
  eng_contrasts_fu(lm_DV2_dur_fu, "DV2", "chat_duration_z"),
  eng_contrasts_fu(lm_DV3_dur_fu, "DV3", "chat_duration_z")
)

eng_condition_r2_fu <- local({
  d <- fu_no_flyer_eng %>% filter(!is.na(chat_duration_min))
  fit <- lm(chat_duration_min ~ Group, data = d)
  a <- anova(fit)
  tibble::tibble(
    Eng_measure = "Chat duration (min)",
    n           = nrow(d),
    R2          = summary(fit)$r.squared,
    R2_adj      = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
    F           = a["Group", "F value"],
    df1         = a["Group", "Df"],
```
