# Sensitivity Analysis: Lenient α = 0.10 Threshold


```{r}
make_alpha10_table <- function(model) {
  emm  <- emmeans(model, ~ Group)
  cons <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "neutral")

  unadj <- summary(cons, adjust = "none", side = ">",
                   infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.90) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(contrast, estimate, SE, df,
           CI90_lower_bound = lower.CL,
           t = t.ratio, p_unadjusted = p.value)

  holm <- summary(cons, adjust = "holm", side = ">") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(contrast, p_holm = p.value)

  unadj %>%
    left_join(holm, by = "contrast") %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(estimate, SE, CI90_lower_bound, t), ~ round(., 3)),
      p_unadjusted = round(p_unadjusted, 4),
      p_holm       = round(p_holm, 4),
      `sig. at .10 (unadj.)` = ifelse(p_unadjusted < 0.10, "yes", "no"),
      `sig. at .10 (Holm)`   = ifelse(p_holm < 0.10, "yes", "no")
    )
}

# Variable naming (sens_DV#_fu) follows the same contr_DV# / tbl_DV#
# pattern used for the other per-DV contrast tables in this document
sens_DV1_fu <- make_alpha10_table(lm_DV1_fu)
sens_DV2_fu <- make_alpha10_table(lm_DV2_fu)
sens_DV3_fu <- make_alpha10_table(lm_DV3_fu)

sens_DV1_fu %>%
  kable(caption = "Perceptions (Follow-Up): Contrasts vs Neutral at the α = .10 Threshold") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

sens_DV2_fu %>%
  kable(caption = "Refugee Support (Follow-Up): Contrasts vs Neutral at the α = .10 Threshold") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

sens_DV3_fu %>%
  kable(caption = "Policy Endorsement (Follow-Up): Contrasts vs Neutral at the α = .10 Threshold") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

# LaTeX export (same "_kbl" + save_kable pattern used throughout this
# document), saved to tables/. Files are self-contained \input-ready
# floats: math-mode alpha in the caption (no Unicode), a \label, and
# LaTeX-safe column headers (escape = FALSE).
save_sensitivity_table_tex <- function(df, caption, label, file) {
  df %>%
    mutate(contrast = relabel_groups_in_string(contrast),
           across(c(p_unadjusted, p_holm), fmt_p)) %>%
    kable(digits = 3, caption = caption, label = label,
          format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
          col.names = c("Contrast", "Estimate", "SE", "$df$", "LB$_{90}$",
                        "$t$", "$p$", "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm}}$",
                        "Sig.\\ at .10 (unadj.)", "Sig.\\ at .10 (Holm)")) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                              latex_options = "scale_down") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}

save_sensitivity_table_tex(sens_DV1_fu, "Perceptions (Follow-Up): Contrasts vs Neutral at the $\\alpha = .10$ Threshold",        "supp_alpha10_dv1", "tables/study3_followup_dv1_sensitivity_alpha10.tex")
save_sensitivity_table_tex(sens_DV2_fu, "Refugee Support (Follow-Up): Contrasts vs Neutral at the $\\alpha = .10$ Threshold",    "supp_alpha10_dv2", "tables/study3_followup_dv2_sensitivity_alpha10.tex")
save_sensitivity_table_tex(sens_DV3_fu, "Policy Endorsement (Follow-Up): Contrasts vs Neutral at the $\\alpha = .10$ Threshold", "supp_alpha10_dv3", "tables/study3_followup_dv3_sensitivity_alpha10.tex")
```



```{r}
# Helpers for the summary below, so that every number in it is pulled from a
# fitted object by inline R rather than typed. summary_pick() requires the row
# it is asked for to exist exactly once, so a renamed condition breaks the
# knit instead of silently printing the wrong contrast.
summary_pick <- function(tbl, cond) {
  row <- tbl %>% filter(contrast == paste(cond, "- neutral"))
  stopifnot(nrow(row) == 1)
  row
}

# Largest treatment-vs-neutral estimate in a contrast table, by name.
summary_top <- function(tbl) {
  str_remove(tbl$contrast[which.max(tbl$estimate)], " - neutral")
}

summary_contrast <- function(tbl, d_tbl, dv_label, cond) {
  row <- summary_pick(tbl, cond)
  d   <- d_tbl %>% filter(DV == dv_label, condition == cond)
  stopifnot(nrow(d) == 1)
  sprintf("$\\Delta$ = %.3f, one-sided *p*~Holm~ = %.3f, *d* = %.2f",
          row$estimate, row$p_holm, d$effect_size)
}

summary_n_sig <- function(tbl, alpha = 0.05) sum(tbl$p_holm < alpha)

summary_sig_word <- function(tbl, cond, alpha = 0.05) {
  if (summary_pick(tbl, cond)$p_holm < alpha) "significant" else "not significant"
}

summary_change <- function(key, cond) {
  row <- dur_change_raw %>% filter(dv_key == key, condition == cond)
  stopifnot(nrow(row) == 1)
  sprintf("%.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], two-sided *p*~Holm~ = %.3f",
          row$estimate, row$CI_low, row$CI_high, row$p_holm)
}

summary_omnibus <- function(dv_label) {
  row <- dur_omnibus %>% filter(DV == dv_label)
  stopifnot(nrow(row) == 1)
  sprintf("*F*(%d, %.0f) = %.2f, *p* = %.3f",
          as.integer(row$NumDF), row$DenDF, row$F, row$p)
}

# The two attrition verdicts are phrased conditionally on the tests, so the
# summary cannot assert "no differential attrition" if the tests stop saying so.
summary_attrition_chisq <- sprintf(
  "%s of condition, $\\chi^2$(%d) = %.2f, *p* = %.3f",
  if (chisq_retention$p.value < 0.05) "**not** independent" else "independent",
  as.integer(chisq_retention$parameter),
  as.numeric(chisq_retention$statistic),
  chisq_retention$p.value
)

attrition_worst <- attrition_ttest_table %>% slice_min(p.value, n = 1)
stopifnot(nrow(attrition_worst) == 1)

summary_attrition_ttests <- if (attrition_worst$p.value < 0.05) {
  sprintf(paste0("returners **differed** from non-returners on %s ",
                 "(returners %.3f vs non-returners %.3f, *t*(%.1f) = %.2f, *p* = %.3f)"),
          attrition_worst$DV, attrition_worst$mean_retained,
          attrition_worst$mean_not_retained, attrition_worst$df,
          attrition_worst$t, attrition_worst$p.value)
} else {
  sprintf("returners did not differ from non-returners on any post-intervention DV (smallest *p* = %.3f)",
          attrition_worst$p.value)
}

# The matched follow-up sample before the pre-registered follow-up exclusions.
n_fu_excluded    <- n_excl_attention + n_excl_speed + n_excl_loweffort
n_fu_before_excl <- n_final + n_fu_excluded
n_fu_chatbot     <- nrow(fu_no_flyer)

# dur_long stacks three DVs at two time points, so it carries six rows per
# chatbot participant; this ties the sample size quoted in the summary to the
# data the durability models were actually fitted on.
stopifnot(n_fu_chatbot == nrow(dur_long) / 6)
```
